<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from 'svelte'
	import * as Field from '$lib/components/ui/field/index.js'
	import { cn } from '$UTILS$.js'
	import { getAuthFormContext, setAuthFieldContext } from './ctx.svelte.js'

	let {
		name,
		class: className = '',
		children
	}: { name: string; class?: string; children: Snippet } = $props()

	const form = getAuthFormContext()
	const field = $derived(form.form.fields[name])
	const invalid = $derived((field?.issues()?.length ?? 0) > 0 ? 'true' : undefined)
	// `.as('text').name` is the stable field id used for label association (type-independent).
	const resolvedName = $derived(field?.as('text').name ?? name)

	setAuthFieldContext({
		get field() {
			return field
		},
		get name() {
			return resolvedName
		}
	})
</script>

<Field.Field data-invalid={invalid} class={cn('', className)}>
	{@render children()}
</Field.Field>

<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from 'svelte'
	import { requestResetPassword } from 'sveltekit-medusa-sdk/auth'
	import { cn } from '$UTILS$.js'
	import { createAuthForm } from './create-auth-form.svelte.js'
	import { resetMessages } from './auth-messages.js'
	import type { AuthMessages, AuthResult } from './types.js'

	let {
		messages = resetMessages,
		onsuccess,
		onswitch,
		onerror,
		class: className = '',
		children
	}: {
		messages?: AuthMessages
		onsuccess?: () => void
		onswitch?: (mode: string) => void
		onerror?: (result: AuthResult) => void
		class?: string
		children: Snippet
	} = $props()

	const auth = createAuthForm(() => ({
		form: requestResetPassword,
		messages,
		onsuccess,
		onswitch,
		onerror
	}))
</script>

<form {...auth.enhanced} oninput={auth.clearError} class={cn('flex flex-col gap-4', className)}>
	{@render children()}
</form>

{#if type === 'password'}
{:else} {/if}

<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from 'svelte'
	import * as Field from '$lib/components/ui/field/index.js'
	import { cn } from '$UTILS$.js'
	import { getAuthFieldContext } from './ctx.svelte.js'
	let { class: className = '', children }: { class?: string; children: Snippet } = $props()
	const ctx = getAuthFieldContext()
</script>

<Field.FieldLabel for={ctx.name} class={cn('', className)}>{@render children()}</Field.FieldLabel>

<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from 'svelte'
	import { login } from 'sveltekit-medusa-sdk/auth'
	import { getCustomer } from 'sveltekit-medusa-sdk/customer'
	import { cn } from '$UTILS$.js'
	import { createAuthForm } from './create-auth-form.svelte.js'
	import { loginMessages } from './auth-messages.js'
	import type { AuthMessages, AuthResult } from './types.js'

	let {
		messages = loginMessages,
		onsuccess,
		onswitch,
		onerror,
		class: className = '',
		children
	}: {
		messages?: AuthMessages
		onsuccess?: () => void
		onswitch?: (mode: string) => void
		onerror?: (result: AuthResult) => void
		class?: string
		children: Snippet
	} = $props()

	const auth = createAuthForm(() => ({
		form: login,
		messages,
		onOk: () => getCustomer().refresh(),
		onsuccess,
		onswitch,
		onerror
	}))
</script>

<form {...auth.enhanced} oninput={auth.clearError} class={cn('flex flex-col gap-4', className)}>
	{@render children()}
</form>

<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from 'svelte'
	import { register } from 'sveltekit-medusa-sdk/auth'
	import { getCustomer } from 'sveltekit-medusa-sdk/customer'
	import { cn } from '$UTILS$.js'
	import { createAuthForm } from './create-auth-form.svelte.js'
	import { registerMessages } from './auth-messages.js'
	import type { AuthMessages, AuthResult } from './types.js'

	let {
		messages = registerMessages,
		onsuccess,
		onswitch,
		onerror,
		class: className = '',
		children
	}: {
		messages?: AuthMessages
		onsuccess?: () => void
		onswitch?: (mode: string) => void
		onerror?: (result: AuthResult) => void
		class?: string
		children: Snippet
	} = $props()

	const auth = createAuthForm(() => ({
		form: register,
		messages,
		onOk: () => getCustomer().refresh(),
		onsuccess,
		onswitch,
		onerror
	}))
</script>

<form {...auth.enhanced} oninput={auth.clearError} class={cn('flex flex-col gap-4', className)}>
	{@render children()}
</form>

<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from 'svelte'
	import { resetPassword } from 'sveltekit-medusa-sdk/auth'
	import { cn } from '$UTILS$.js'
	import { createAuthForm } from './create-auth-form.svelte.js'
	import { resetMessages } from './auth-messages.js'
	import type { AuthMessages, AuthResult } from './types.js'

	let {
		messages = resetMessages,
		token = '',
		onsuccess,
		onswitch,
		onerror,
		class: className = '',
		children
	}: {
		messages?: AuthMessages
		token?: string
		onsuccess?: () => void
		onswitch?: (mode: string) => void
		onerror?: (result: AuthResult) => void
		class?: string
		children: Snippet
	} = $props()

	const auth = createAuthForm(() => ({
		form: resetPassword,
		messages,
		onsuccess,
		onswitch,
		onerror
	}))
</script>

<form {...auth.enhanced} oninput={auth.clearError} class={cn('flex flex-col gap-4', className)}>
	<!-- The reset token comes from the URL, not user input. Post it as a hidden field under the
	     form's own field name; native form submission sends DOM values, so no field-state seeding
	     is needed and `value` stays a plain reactive binding (SSR-safe, no effect/derived). -->
	<input type="hidden" name={resetPassword.fields.token?.as('text').name} value={token} />
	{@render children()}
</form>

<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from 'svelte'
	import { Button } from '$lib/components/ui/button/index.js'
	import { cn } from '$UTILS$.js'
	import { getAuthFormContext } from './ctx.svelte.js'
	let { class: className = '', children }: { class?: string; children: Snippet } = $props()
	const ctx = getAuthFormContext()
</script>

<Button type="submit" disabled={ctx.submitting} class={cn('w-full', className)}
	>{@render children()}</Button
>
